At some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''subjugated''' the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region known as the [[Jahilid Drift]].

==History==
More than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]] led a strike force to conquer several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] along the [[Jahilid Drift]], including [[Pral]] and [[Koltine]]. Sk'ar's victories in the region led to a boost in his reputation, even among the most [[Speciesism/Legends|speciesist]] [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="Hyperspace" />
